basis: committed_bytes is the measured figure of each block as last raised, and the base of the code ceiling (1.5 x, acceptance/validate/payload_rule.py). Block limits are the reviewed floor: measured + 1 percent rounded up to 1000 B, or up to measured + 5 percent where a justification below records a deliberate raise (release F1, carrier 9: every block re-raised with tools/panel_payload_size.py --raise-all --margin 0.05 on the F1 candidate 6a6bdb2e, so every block carries 5 percent). The physical floors carry at least 5 percent of the limit as headroom over the F1 figures (history entry 6a6bdb2e). Weekly growth is NOT edited here: lint.payload_size computes each limit from the previous committed release (#893), but that relative rule never goes below these floors and never above the ceiling. Raise a floor only by rerunning tools/panel_payload_size.py --raise-all in the change that deliberately grows a block.
